verdict.rationale: Yapily Connect is explicitly documented as a ready-built, white-label hosted UI for AIS/PIS flows with pre-built institution selection and consent screens, no frontend engineering required, automatic SCA/redirect handling, and customizable branding — matching the drop-in widget story closely. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the server-side 'create session' API call and the exact token/consent-object returned to the backend after widget completion, plus independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
